title: CardUndo
description: Payload: the owner undid a card's most recent revision (S9). It names the CardRevised it reverses and states the card it restores; the ledger checks that is the most recent revision not yet undone, for this card, and that 'restored' is that revision's 'previous'. Undo walks back one revision at a time.

revisionEventSeq.description: Ledger position of the CardRevised being undone.
